post.summary: Migrate live instances to another version (or dry-run the plan)
post.description: Each instance is closed out (status `migrated`, open tasks cancelled, queued resumes dropped) and a new run starts on the target version at the chosen node with the same variables, trace and task (a User Task there creates a fresh task). post.description: You must be able to work on the open task (assignee, collaborator, team member, a manager of an assignee, tasks.complete_any, or tasks.manage_queue on a non-workflow task); needs a user-bound credential. With content_base64: the file is checked (size, type by content, blocked types, SVG sanitising, optional virus scan) and attached; returns `{ mode: "uploaded", attachment }`.
